title: Geologic map of the Long Branch quadrangle, Barnwell County, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 1996, Geologic map of the Long Branch quadrangle, Barnwell County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-80, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet with a long OCR'd explanation; columns OCR'd cleanly here. Symbols Qcb, Tp, Tal and Ttr read from legend boxes on a page image. The Pinehurst-on-Altamaha elevation of 600 feet is at Summit, Lexington County (outside the quadrangle), cited from Kite (1985b). The Altamaha exposure on Virginia Avenue is just south of the map in Snelling quadrangle. Alluvium was not drilled in the quadrangle; its description relies on holes elsewhere. Map-face hole labels (e.g. 6-249) not recorded; early holes Barnwell County Nos. 22-76 are mentioned only as a group. Thirteen SC-relevant references kept. SUBSURFACE: Pinehurst deposits east of Summit lie about 350 feet below the base of the Altamaha Formation (Kite, 1985a), no location precise enough for a surface; Dry Branch locally up to thirty feet above flood plain level.
